# LongRangeInteractions

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Interactions in a spin system that decay algebraically with distance, enabling non-local coupling between spins beyond nearest neighbors. Mimics the long-range connectivity in TCC/iNEST topologies, allowing the study of emergent collective behavior relevant to network-based computing.
